description: Passes of legacy files: points of one file in one continuous stretch of GPS time (split at gaps > flightlines.gap_s). Written per file and concatenated per scope.

columns.name: t_start_s
columns.description: GPS time in the time domain (adjusted standard for abs)

columns.name: heading_deg
columns.description: From the least-squares x(t), y(t) of all points; clockwise from grid north

columns.name: cx_m
columns.description: Midpoint of the pass's x extent (EPSG:6345). Used for linking.

columns.name: nadir_x_m
columns.description: Diagnostic: ground track at mid time from |scan| <= flightlines.nadir_deg returns; null without enough nadir points

columns.name: height_m
columns.description: Diagnostic: flying height above ground from cross-track offset ~ H tan(scan)

columns.name: psid_share
columns.description: Share of the pass's points with psid_mode
